prototypes.label: B1 · Vivo y equilibrado
prototypes.prompt: Edit the supplied reference B. Preserve exactly its vertical 9:16 composition, ship shape and exaggerated cartoon proportions, large funnels, rounded billowing smoke forms, palace architecture, palm shapes, thick expressive black inking, waves, perspective and spacious lower caption area. Change ONLY the color treatment and the flat cel shading, not the scene or composition. User wants objects in their proper recognizable colors, intensified into vivid electric comic colors. The logo's pink and lime must NOT dictate the scene. Sky must be luminous BLUE, clouds WHITE with blue-gray shadows, chimney smoke CHARCOAL GRAY, sea saturated BLUE/TURQUOISE with WHITE foam, palm fronds rich GREEN and trunks warm BROWN, palace WHITE/CREAM with golden sandstone details and plausible terracotta roofs, ship hull BLACK/navy charcoal, upper ship IVORY/WHITE, wooden deck warm BROWN, funnels rich ochre ORANGE with BLACK tops, brass details GOLD. No pink sky, no purple clouds, no fluorescent green smoke or architecture, no multicolored wash, no brand-color outlines. The colors are punchy painted pigments, NOT emitted neon light. Maintain very strong black outlines, playful exaggerated 2D comic drawing, no photorealism, no 3D, no lettering or logo. This is a palette comparison prototype, not a historically exact documentary. PALETTE VARIANT B1: crisp tropical daylight, clear saturated azure sky and turquoise sea, emerald palms, warm ivory palace. Vivid high chroma but pleasantly balanced; preserve plenty of white and dark neutral breathing room. Simple clean two-tone cel shadows, strong contrast without crushing shadow detail.
